items.reason: The process type guard fails to recognize spawn-context workers, leaving hung workers alive when replacements start.
The shared join deadline causes the cleanup loop to break, skipping termination of remaining workers.
submit repeats the same cluster-wide Redis memory query for each process-specific buffer.
The docstring incorrectly promises one process per shard although workers are capped and may handle multiple shards.
The isinstance guard excludes SpawnProcess workers, so hung workers survive replacement and become unmanaged.
The restart path fails to kill hung spawn-context workers because it checks against the wrong process class.
join stops the worker cleanup loop when its shared deadline expires, leaving remaining workers without termination cleanup.
